notes: router flagged the popmenu payload as wrong-branch (Murrieta address); confirmed correct Carlsbad location (5671 Palmer Way) via a separate Uber Eats store listing with matching address. Only one 'Bowls' category exists (no separate smoothies section on the page), 9 named bowls -- reads as a complete small-menu capture, not a carousel sample.

dishes.name: Campground Bowl
dishes.description: The Campground is the best of both worlds. The base is half organic açai and half organic pitaya (dragon fruit) with blueberry flax seed granola and fresh strawberries, bananas, and blueberries.

dishes.name: Doho Bowl
dishes.description: If you like Nutella this is your bowl!. The base is organic açai topped with blueberry flaxseed granola, fresh strawberries, fresh bananas, nutella, and coconut flakes.

dishes.name: Lowers Bowl
dishes.description: The Lowers is for all those peanut butter lovers out there. The base is organic açai topped with blueberry flax seed granola, fresh strawberries, bananas, and of course, a generous portion of peanut butter drizzle.

dishes.name: Moonlight Bowl
dishes.description: Acai Sorbet, Blueberry Flax Granola, Strawberries, Banana, and Mango

dishes.name: Ponto Pitaya Bowl
dishes.description: So refreshing. The base is pitaya (dragon fruit) topped with blueberry flaxseed granola, fresh strawberries, and bananas.

dishes.name: Stone Steps Bowl
dishes.description: A base of protein-rich acai is topped with crunchy granola, creamy peanut butter, fresh strawberries, ripe bananas, sliced almonds, and nutrient-packed hemp seeds.

dishes.name: Swamis Bowl
dishes.description: Simple, but so refreshing. The base is organic açai topped with blueberry flaxseed granola, fresh strawberries, and bananas.

dishes.name: T-Street Bowl
dishes.description: The T-Street açai bowl comes packed with all the traditional topping. The base is organic açai topped with blueberry flax seed granola. We then add fresh strawberries, bananas, and blueberries. Lastly, it's finished with a generous amount of honey and coconut shavings. No disappointments here!

dishes.name: Uppers Bowl
dishes.description: The Uppers is for all those Reese's Peanut Butter Cup lovers. The base is organic açai and is topped with blueberry flax seed granola, fresh strawberries and bananas. Added to that is a little peanut butter and Nutella drizzle . . . Delicious!
